profit_quality.assessment: Reported profit is unusable as the control earnback denominator because 2025 profit was dominated by a HK$3.2473b associate disposal gain. The controlled display business weakened from HK$88.079m segment profit in 2023 to HK$54.956m in 2024 and HK$1.492m segment loss in 2025. Latest-year operating cash flow was only HK$14.518m and capex was HK$156.392m, so distributable cash profit is heavily discounted.
adjustments: Excluded HK$3.2473b gain on disposal of an associate.
Excluded associate share of results and FVTPL fair value movements from controlled operating profit.
Used three-year display segment profit median HK$54.956m as pre-haircut sustainable cash-profit proxy.
Applied 0.45 profit haircut for weak latest-year segment result, low operating cash flow, receivables build and high capex.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Latest-year operating cash conversion is poor and display segment profit turned negative; investment/disposal gains dominate reported profit.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak in 2025; operating cash flow covered only 26.4% of the HK$54.956m median segment profit proxy and did not cover capex.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance/growth split not disclosed; 2025 capex HK$156.392m was far above the prior two years, so profit haircut rather than best-year FCF is used.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 trade and other receivables increased HK$69.833m in the cash-flow bridge, materially consuming operating cash.
